description: Access skill for the Ministry of Culture and Tourism of the People's Republic of China's

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - fetch_document   Fetch and parse a single government document by URL
  - fetch_documents   Fetch and parse multiple government documents by URLs
  - list_documents   List available government documents from the portal

url.description: The document URL (full URL or relative path)

urls.description: List of document URLs to fetch

category.description:
Optional category filter. Common categories include:
- zykf: 资源开发 (Resource Development)
- zcfg: 政策法规 (Policies and Regulations)
- bmgz: 部门规章 (Departmental Rules)
- scgl: 市场管理 (Market Management)
- tjxx: 统计信息 (Statistical Information)

limit.description: Maximum number of documents to return
